name: Reverse UI
tagline: Animated components, reverse-engineered from the web
description: A paid collection of hand-built, Framer Motion-powered components recreated from the most polished sites on the web. Every component ships as original code, styled for Tailwind or Emotion, and installs via copy-paste, an npm package or the GitHub repo.
